title: Sandwich Attack on Auto-Compound (Missing Slippage Protection)
description: The _tryCompound() function reads the current spot price from slot0 and uses it to calculate liquidity amounts. There is no minimum liquidity check or slippage protection. MEV bots can sandwich the compound operation by manipulating price before the compound, then reversing after. The hook adds liquidity at a skewed ratio, losing value to the MEV bot.
impact: Value leak from accumulated fees through suboptimal compounding
attackPath: Monitor mempool for swaps that trigger compound or poke() calls
Front-run with large swap to manipulate slot0 price toward tick boundary
Compound executes using manipulated price, adds liquidity at bad ratio
Back-run to restore price and capture arbitrage
rootCause: No slippage protection in modifyLiquidity call, uses manipulable slot0 price
recommendation: Add minimum liquidity output parameter or use TWAP price instead of slot0 for calculating liquidity ratios
